chapter: Police work, brass bands and carnival
title: Mardi Gras and carnival club parades
summary: He played the white carnival parades for the Eleonora and Lions clubs, for about four years with the Lions and three with another marching club.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: appetizer on, started on trucks you know. And what about Mardi Gras? Did you play many of those

the carnival? Oh yeah, I worked those white parades. I worked the carnival club, I worked the Eleonora, the Eleonora club, worked for the Lions, and jumped you know from one year to the other because they all paid big prices you know. I worked for the Lions for about four years straight. When I was working over in the pad at Funk and Manders. Then they formed a marching club. Well that made me, by me working there on Sundays, me and Howard and them working on Sundays, we worked at Matt and Lee. That made me just take over for their parade. Then I had to find a way to get another band for them. Well they operated for about three years, I played for them about three years on the parade. .
